name: BunZ
blocked: needs-browser: batch website (bunzsd.com) is a dead Wix domain-connect error page; Yelp is bot-walled (776-byte challenge response); the restaurant's own Toast ordering page is a client-side-rendered SPA with zero embedded menu/price data in the static HTML (no __NEXT_DATA__ or similar payload) so its catalog is only reachable via API calls a plain fetch can't make. Only sources with visible prices are third-party delivery mirrors (UberEats, Postmates) which are single-source tier-5 platforms likely carrying delivery markup and were not corroborated by a second independent-owner source in the time budget. Hours listings on Toast/Yelp suggest it is still operating, so this is NOT filed as not_found.
